about: Synthetic payment records (Acct<oid>/Paymts) for docs/format/04-payments-and-bookings.md: records produced with Banking4 (built_by record_writer) and cases in forms Banking4 does not write as a whole record (built_by primitive_writer), all with their expected results. Do not edit.

notation.file: A collection file: records back to back, each a 32-bit little-endian size followed by that many bytes. offset is the position of the size, record_size its value, chunk_sizes the sizes of the record's chunks.
notation.built_by: record_writer: a record in a form Banking4 writes as a whole, produced with Banking4; set holds the in-memory values before writing. primitive_writer: a case in a form Banking4 does not write as a whole record; wire holds the values in wire order.
notation.read: The expected result of reading the bytes for an account of the given kind and currency: fields are the in-memory values after all adjustments Banking4 makes on reading, derived are values Banking4 computes from them. more_chunks_left tells whether reading stops in a chunk that has a successor. rewritten is "identical" if writing the record again after reading it gives the same bytes; otherwise it gives offset and record_size of the expected result of writing it again, in rewritten_file, which is a collection file of the same kind. If Banking4 rejects the record, error names the kind of failure instead: invalid_value for a value Banking4 does not accept, invalid_number for a text that is not a number, record_codec_error for a failure of the wire format itself, json_syntax_error for a text that is not the JSON Banking4 expects.
notation.read_other_accounts: The expected result of reading the same bytes for other accounts; only the values that differ from read are listed. An account_currency of null is an account without a currency of its own; default_currency is the application default currency that applies in that case.
notation.collection_load: The expected result of loading the file without the records named in rejected_by_reader, for the account of read: items lists the records in the resulting order, each with the values that differ from its read (Banking4 changes some values, and regroups masters and slaves). Banking4 rejects the records in rejected_by_reader on reading and stops loading a file at the first such record. dropped names the records Banking4 discards.
notation.values: Decimals are strings that keep their scale. Raw dates are "YYYY-MM-DD" with the three parts as stored (unvalidated, so 2024-00-00 can occur) or null. Timestamps are "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.fffffff" or null for the zero timestamp. Times are "HH:MM:SS" or null. Enumerations and bit sets are numbers. Multi-line texts are arrays of lines. payee_verification_json is the JSON text of the object held in memory. Characters outside printable ASCII are escaped.
